decks.notes: The main concept of this Izzet Control deck is to focus on card advantage and control through a combination of card draw, removal spells, and counter magic. By utilizing cards like Jeskai Revelation, Firebending Lesson, and Abandon Attachments, the deck aims to outvalue opponents while disrupting their game plan with counterspells like Iroh's Demonstration and Splatter Technique. The deck also includes various lands to ensure mana consistency and ways to get ahead on resources with cards like Great Hall of the Biblioplex and Tablet of Discovery. Overall, the goal is to outlast opponents and win through attrition.

The main concept of this UR Aggro deck is to quickly establish board presence and deal damage to the opponent as fast as possible. Utilizing efficient card draw and cheap spells to control the board early on, while building up a threatening board state with aggressive creatures like Eddymurk Crab and Slickshot Show-Off. Burst Lightning and Boomerang Basics provide direct damage and tempo advantage, allowing the deck to close out games swiftly. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of spells, creatures, and burn spells to secure a fast victory.

The deck focuses on disrupting opponent's strategy while maintaining control of the game through a combination of counter spells, removal, and card draw. By using cards like Burst Lightning, Spell Snare, and Impractical Joke to disrupt opponent's plays, and cards like Opt, Sleight of Hand, and Winternight Stories to draw more cards and find key pieces, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent. Additionally, the deck utilizes cards like Hearth Elemental and Traumatic Critique to pressure the opponent and close out the game once control has been established.

This mono green aggro deck focuses on overwhelming the opponent with a fast and aggressive creature strategy. Utilizing efficient mana ramp with cards like Llanowar Elves, players aim to play high-power creatures like Craterhoof Behemoth and Earth's Mightiest Heroes to quickly drain the opponent's life total. Surrak, Elusive Hunter provides versatility and evasion, while Gene Pollinator and Ouroboroid offer additional value and resilience. The deck aims to establish board presence early and maintain pressure on the opponent until victory is achieved.

The main concept of this UR Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of efficient creatures and cheap, versatile spells. By utilizing cards like Sleight of Hand and Opt to dig for key pieces, along with disruptive spells like Spell Pierce to protect its threats, the deck aims to control the board and apply pressure quickly. Additionally, cards like Boomerang Basics and Riverpyre Verge provide additional utility and tempo advantage, while cards like Burst Lightning and Stormchaser's Talent allow for reach and direct damage to close out games.

The main focus of this Selesnya Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a mix of powerful creatures like Leatherhead, Swamp Stalker and Surrak, Elusive Hunter, supported by efficient mana ramping from Llanowar Elves and Abandoned Air Temple. Practiced Offense and Brightglass Gearhulk provide additional aggression, while Spider Manifestation and Ouroboroid offer resilience and versatility. Multiversal Passage and Hushwood Verge enable color fixing and ramping, ensuring a smooth mana curve to maintain pressure on the opponent. The deck is designed to quickly build a threatening board presence and push for a swift victory.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures and then bringing them back onto the battlefield for a devastating combo. Cards like Day of Black Sun, Requiting Hex, and Restless Reef help facilitate this strategy, while cards like Superior Spider-Man provide strong reanimation targets. The deck includes a mix of control elements with cards like Duress and Deadly Cover-Up to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and control spells to secure victory.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures and then bring them back onto the battlefield through reanimation spells. The deck includes a variety of ways to discard cards, such as Duress and Stock Up, as well as powerful reanimation spells like Requiting Hex and Doomsday Excruciator. By efficiently filling the graveyard and bringing back powerful creatures, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a quick and powerful combo before they have a chance to respond.

This deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly with aggressive creatures and cheap spells. Using cards like Boomerang Basics, Burst Lightning, and Slickshot Show-Off to deal damage and control the board, while also having card draw and mana fixing with Opt and Multiversal Passage. The deck has a low mana curve and focuses on tempo plays to maintain pressure on the opponent. Utilizing UR colors for versatility and efficiency, this deck aims to win games quickly through a combination of creature damage and direct burn spells.

Eddymurk Crab and Hearth Elemental provide a solid defensive wall, while cards like Prismari Charm and Burst Lightning offer removal and versatility. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent and control the game until it can win with a combination of burn spells and efficient threats.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through a mixture of card draw, removal spells, and powerful finishers like Thor, God of Thunder and Jeskai Revelation. Using a variety of mana sources and card advantage engines like Tablet of Discovery and Accumulate Wisdom, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast opponents by efficiently answering threats and generating incremental advantage over time. By carefully managing resources and using powerful cards like Gran-Gran and Combustion Technique at the right moments, the deck seeks to establish dominance and overwhelm opponents in the late game.
